claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_ongoing_field
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item fits MagicItemRecord and composite mechanics for its held passive benefits and granted spells, but Protective Aura is a temporary anchored field that continuously grants benefits to qualifying creatures in an area. Current magic-item mechanics only allow passive, activation, triggered_reaction, or composites of those; none can honestly express an activated ongoing area effect with entry/exit semantics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground ... While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: attachment.area.selection_filter = allies_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura's AC and saving throw bonus is not for every creature in the bright-light area; it is limited to the wielder and allies. Existing area attachments do not carry affiliation filters.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.item_removed_from_anchor
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura ends early when any creature uses a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. Existing duration early-end triggers do not cover item-anchor removal by an explicit action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground.
